in_marathi.name: Vijayanti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vijayanti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijaya' meaning victory, and 'Anti' meaning endless. Often given to children born during auspicious times.

in_bengali.name: Vijayanti
